$comment: The expo-updates fingerprints of the binaries currently in users' hands.
An `eas update` only reaches a build whose fingerprint matches exactly;
publishing to any other value reports success and reaches zero devices,
with no error anywhere. scripts/verify-ota-target.mjs compares the working
tree against this file and refuses to publish on a mismatch.
Update this file in the same commit that ships a new binary, and never to
silence the preflight — a mismatch means the update cannot land, not that

android.$note: Built from main 62e9f57 (EAS build 21641ad1, workflow run 33969667328) and submitted to the Play closed alpha 2026-09-05 14:07 UTC; a production release 0.1.4 (71) was created from the library the same day and sent for review as a full rollout (which restarted the alpha review). First binary with the full R8 pipeline (#112): optimize base, full mode, optimized resource shrinking, narrowed keeps, React Native core Image retired. Play bundle explorer: App optimization High (70 was Medium), obfuscation 80%, R8 checklist green on Full Mode, Resource Shrinking and Resource Shrinking Optimized (Repackage Classes and AGP 9 outstanding), install size 20.4 MB, -3.27 MB vs 70. Play review landed the same day: 71 has been live on production since 2026-09-05 20:14 IST (full rollout, 177 countries) and is the only Active bundle, so Android users run 71 at this fingerprint.

ios.$note: Built from main 2bf292b (EAS build e20859dc) and submitted to TestFlight 2026-09-09, then installed and exercised on a physical iPhone. First iOS binary carrying patches/expo-video+55.0.21.patch, which bounds expo-video's content-information request to `Range: bytes=0-1` (F1 in the media delivery audit): measured 2.87x -> 1.88x bytes-per-open on a 466 KB clip, 1.96x on a 1.48 MB clip. Replaces build 51, which was pulled from App Store review to make room and is now in nobody's hands - this file recorded 51 until 2026-09-09, so any iOS update published in between targeted a fingerprint no device carried. App Store 0.1.4 (52) was rejected 2026-09-09 under guidelines 5.2.1 and 2.3.10 (demo-account content and non-iOS screenshots - version metadata, not the binary) and resubmitted the same day; until that is approved App Store users still run 0.1.2 (47), so an update published against this fingerprint reaches TestFlight only. This fingerprint equals main at 2bf292b, so JS-only updates from main can reach build 52 - the block that stood while 51 was current is lifted.
